title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode4 Looking for a Hint

meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Your chocolate parfait and a cup of hot tea.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh, the parfait's mine!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Time to dig in!
Oh, wow... It's so good♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's so warm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's because you were walking around in this weather without an umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. At least my clothes are starting to dry out now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank goodness! And why don't you get something to eat, Kanade? I'll pay too since I kinda dragged you in here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks, but I'm really not that hungry.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay...
But tell me if you do, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And isn't this place great?
I love this place so much since everything on the menu's amazing and the adorable decor.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So is the demo giving you a rough time...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It is. I haven't made much progress...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I see.
But you don't need to feel rushed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The demo that I had you all listen to didn't really resonate with Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So I need to finish another one for tonight.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that I'm just going to get the same result...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Resonate...? You won't know until you try! I think you should just have her give it a listen, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's not just that.
A part of me knows that it won't.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Luka even said so.
That it won't clear up what's on Mafuyu's mind.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Clear up what's on her mind...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't quite put my finger on it, but I think I know what Luka was trying to say. I haven't made up my mind yet, and it's why I feel so lost.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Nothing's going to work at this rate...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade's really in trouble, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't know anything about songwriting...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I want to help her in any way I can...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're really up a creek, huh? And Luka said that your song won't help Mafuyu as it is...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we go out and do something together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What? You mean right now...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! You need to clear your head, right? Being cooped up at home definitely won't help, so why not get a breath of fresh air instead?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who knows? You might even find something that'll help you save Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The trip that Mizuki suggested we all go on did give us some ideas for a new song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe seeing something new is the right answer in this case too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And if it means that I'll be able to compose a song that can save Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay...
Take me somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you got it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I probably should've decided on something before suggesting this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let me think... Got it! We can start with that place! Follow me, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...!
Doll Store

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A doll store...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember how Mafuyu reacted when we all went to that Doll Exhibit?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I thought that it might help you figure out something too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I wasn't directly responsible for that. Which means... I have to come up with something more powerful than that...)
se_event_carnation_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That sound... Is it a music box?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think it's this doll...
se_event_carnation_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it plays a music box when you wind it up! That's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
It's a nice song too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you include a lot of music box sounds in your songs, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even that last one you made. It's like you're putting your signature on each song, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I never thought about it like that...
But I do like music boxes quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Especially the one my dad made.
I used to listen to that one a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That might be why I'm so fascinated by them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It must've been a really good song.
What was it like?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It was so gentle...
Just listening to it made you feel...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Did I pry too hard there...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, let's check out our next stop...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uh, sure. Okay...
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Phew... We really looked all over.
How are you feeling? Tired?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I feel good. It's a weekday so there aren't that many people around, but I still haven't figured anything out regarding Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
I felt like that art exhibit with all those landscapes would do the trick too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I can see why. Mafuyu smiled when we saw those cherry blossoms so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's even been complimenting Ena's artwork too, sometimes. Maybe art's the key to getting her to feel more?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. If we keep looking at artsy things, we might just...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? What's up?
Did that flower shop catch your eye...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Carnations...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mom loved carnations so much...)
